children: JM is starting production of the Vyn project, which comprises 95 tenant-owned units in Huvudsta Strandpark.

Vyn is a continuation of a previously started block in Huvudsta Strandpark, located in a leafy area of Solna with close proximity to public transport, services and many of Greater Stockholm’s workplaces. The project comprises three stairwells, a garage and a courtyard, and offers views of natural surroundings as well as close proximity to sunny bathing areas by Ulvsundasjön.

Sales are underway and occupancy is planned for the fourth quarter of 2027, with completion estimated in the second quarter of 2028. The housing start is reported within the JM Stockholm business segment in the third quarter of 2026.

– We are very pleased that JM has has now started production of Vyn. Together with the previously started Utblicken project, Vyn’s 95 residential units will enable us to complete the first tenant-owned residential block in Huvudsta Strandpark, says Erik Ragnerstam, Regional Manager Greater Stockholm, JM Stockholm.
Erik Ragnerstam, Regional Manager Greater Stockholm, JM Stockholm, +46 8 782 13 48
Katarina Rimmerfeldt, Head of Group Communications, +46 73 432 61 20,

JM is the leading developer of housing and residential areas in the Nordic region. Operations focus on new-build housing in attractive locations, with emphasis on metropolitan areas and growth regions in Sweden, Norway and Finland. JM operates with a long-term perspective, with sustainability issues integrated into the business. Annual sales total approximately SEK 11 billion and the company has about 1,900 employees. JM is a public limited company listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, Large Cap segment. For more information visit www.jm.se/en
